entities.name: Query kynureninase
observations: 481 aa sequence; estimated molecular weight 49.84 kDa and theoretical pI 5.18.
Strong homology to reviewed bacterial kynureninases: 44.5–44.9% identity, 85.9–87.3% query coverage, E-values 4.95e-105 to 6.21e-106.
Sequence contains Aminotran_5 domain (PF00266.26; residues 196–385) and KYNU_C domain (PF22580.3; residues 375–476).
Likely cytosolic PLP-dependent enzyme and probable homodimer by homolog-supported annotation; exact function remains sequence-based inference without direct assay.

entities.name: Bacterial kynureninase
observations: Reviewed homologs catalyze PLP-dependent cleavage of L-kynurenine to anthranilate and L-alanine, and 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine to 3-hydroxyanthranilate and L-alanine.
Annotated EC 3.7.1.3; homologs are cytosolic homodimers.
A conserved lysine is annotated as the N6-(pyridoxal 5'-phosphate) Schiff-base residue in reference kynureninases.

entities.name: Pyridoxal 5-phosphate
observations: PLP is the cofactor annotated for the closest reviewed kynurenase homologs.

entities.name: Kynurenine cleavage
observations: Candidate reaction: L-kynurenine + H2O → anthranilate + L-alanine + H(+); Rhea RHEA:16813.

entities.name: 3-Hydroxykynurenine cleavage
observations: Candidate reaction: 3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H2O → 3-hydroxyanthranilate + L-alanine + H(+); Rhea RHEA:25143.
